purpose: State an intended purpose or a cause that explains a result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Purpose: dictionary-form intentional verb + ために; noun + のために. Cause: plain clause + ために; noun + のために; な-adjective + なために.
School was closed because of heavy snow.
Because the message arrived late, the preparations were not ready in time.
I am studying Japanese in order to work in Japan.
Aim at an action, an ability, or avoiding an outcome
formation: Purpose: dictionary-form intentional verb + ために; noun + のために. Cause: plain clause + ために; noun + のために; な-adjective + なために.
restrictions: Purpose ために presents a goal the action is directed toward. With causes, it explains a result, often in reports. ように often frames a desired state or ability; context and the speaker’s perspective matter.
mistake: Do not read every ために as because. Purpose and cause have different time relationships; a past cause can use 雨が降ったために.
